project_type: SvelteKit 3 (Svelte 5 runes) app with adapter-node; server-side services over Drizzle 0.45 / Postgres 18; pure bracket engine in src/lib/brackets; org-scoped REST API in src/lib/server/api + src/routes/api/v1
build_system: pnpm 10.28 via corepack (`corepack pnpm <cmd>`; pnpm is not on PATH). Vite 8 + @sveltejs/kit 3; the kit options live in `sveltekit({...})` in vite.config.ts (there is NO svelte.config.js and no `csp`). Zod 4.6 (lazy messages `{ error: () => m.key() }` verified). Paraglide 2.29.3 compiles messages/en.json into src/lib/paraglide (gitignored) via the Vite plugin and the `paraglide-js compile` CLI in the `check`/`prepare` scripts (the CLI supports `--strategy`). `#lib/...` imports MUST include the file extension (`#lib/server/db/index.ts`, `#lib/paraglide/messages.js`); relative imports inside a folder omit it (`./errors`). Env vars are declared in src/env.ts (`defineEnvVars`, `optional` schema) and read with `import { X } from '$app/env/private'`.
test_framework: Vitest 4 with two projects in vite.config.ts: `server` (src/**/*.spec.ts, pure, no DATABASE_URL in CI) and `db` (src/**/*.db.spec.ts against TEST_DATABASE_URL tournament_test, schema recreated by src/lib/server/testing/db-setup.ts, files serial, env AUTH_MODULES=dev, no STEAM_API_KEY). `expect.requireAssertions: true`. Anything importing a service, #lib/server/db, api/schemas.ts, api/endpoints.ts or a route module MUST be a *.db.spec.ts. Playwright e2e in e2e/*.e2e.ts; webServer runs `node scripts/migrate.js && pnpm build && node build` on :4173 against E2E_DATABASE_URL (tournament_e2e, kept between runs, so names use uniqueName) with AUTH_MODULES=dev, TRUSTED_AUTH_MODULES=dev, ALLOW_DEV_AUTH=true, PROTOCOL_HEADER=x-forwarded-proto; extraHTTPHeaders X-Forwarded-Proto: http (new contexts must pass it too). Playwright name/label matching is substring and case-insensitive.
test_command: corepack pnpm test:unit --run   (e2e: $env:PATH = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\corepack-shims;$env:PATH"; corepack pnpm test:e2e)
verification_instructions: 1) corepack pnpm format (also formats .agents/**, which prettier checks). 2) corepack pnpm check -> 0 errors, 0 warnings (baseline today 0/0). 3) corepack pnpm lint (prettier --check . && eslint .). 4) corepack pnpm test:unit --run -> all pass (baseline before M8: 29 files / 332 tests). One file or folder: corepack pnpm test:unit --run src/lib/server/services/steam.db.spec.ts. 5) e2e in the SAME shell call: $env:PATH = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\corepack-shims;$env:PATH"; corepack pnpm test:e2e (baseline 11 passed at M7; allow a 20+ min timeout; one file: ... corepack pnpm test:e2e e2e/steam.e2e.ts). Schema change: corepack pnpm db:generate --name steam_games (if drizzle-kit says DATABASE_URL is not set, prefix $env:DATABASE_URL='postgres://root:mysecretpassword@localhost:5432/local';), then corepack pnpm db:migrate.
snapshot_or_generated_files: drizzle/0005_steam_games.sql, drizzle/meta/0005_snapshot.json and the drizzle/meta/_journal.json entry are generated by `corepack pnpm db:generate --name steam_games` (FEAT-001) and committed with the schema change; never hand-edit them. src/lib/paraglide is generated and gitignored.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell (5: use [IO.File]::ReadAllText or -LiteralPath for paths with [brackets]); each shell call is a fresh session, so env changes (PATH, DATABASE_URL) must be set in the same command. Postgres runs in Docker container tournament-db-1 (healthy); databases local, tournament_test, tournament_e2e exist; if Docker is down run `corepack pnpm db:start` and retry `docker info`. Never skip db or e2e tests. Playwright Chromium is installed; pnpm shims for its webServer are at %LOCALAPPDATA%\corepack-shims. git core.autocrlf=true (never change git config): if git status lists many files ' M' with an empty `git diff`, that's stat noise, never stage those. .env exists and must never be committed. .agents/ is untracked and must never be staged. Do NOT commit in FEAT steps: the single M8 commit happens in the final step. Never push. No new dependencies. Do NOT change the CSRF behaviour (kit csrf options, hooks origin checks): the M7 CSRF/403 finding is pending a user decision. NEVER let a test call Steam: services take an injected `fetch` (mockFetch); e2e seeds a fresh cache and aborts the CDN with page.route.
contribution_requirements: Match existing style exactly: tabs, single quotes, no trailing commas, printWidth 100 (prettier.config.js); terse doc comments in the existing tone (see services/*.ts). Every UI string in messages/en.json via Paraglide `m.key()`; from FEAT-004 on, also every ServiceError/IdentityError/AuthModuleError, Zod (lazy), guard and flash message; API-only code (src/lib/server/api/**, auth/apiKey.ts, routes/api/**) and operator startup errors stay English. Core rule (docs/PLAN.md): UI form actions and REST endpoints call the same services/* functions; authorization in guards at the edge (requireUser, requireOrgRole, requireTournamentAdmin, requireApiKey/requireApiTournament); services enforce phase rules and throw ServiceError(message, kind). Never put business logic in route handlers. Svelte: `let { data, form }: PageProps = $props()`, `$derived`, `$state`, `resolve('/route/[param]', params)` from $app/paths for every non-fragment href (eslint svelte/no-navigation-without-resolve), `<style lang="scss">` with `@use 'tokens' as *;` only when breakpoints are needed, CSS custom properties for colors. Migrations generated with drizzle-kit. Commit (final step only): subject 'Add profiles with results, the Steam game picker and polish (M8)' + bullet body + 'Verified: …' + Co-Authored-By trailer like `git show -s HEAD`. docs/PLAN.md: M8 ✅ row with its Done when + '## Implementation notes (M8)' after the M7 notes; README: Steam games, Profiles, Translations sections.
key_patterns:
Guards throw SvelteKit `error(status, message)`. Services: `db.transaction(async (tx) => …)`; results via services/matches.ts setMatchResult/clearMatchResult/reportResult (lockStage + refreshStage), publish to events.ts after commit. UI actions: `const { tournament } = await requireTournamentAdmin(event)`; `try { await service() } catch (e) { if (e instanceof ServiceError) return fail(400, { error: e.message }); throw e; }`; success alerts `

`, errors `

`; fields `
directory_structure: src/lib/brackets (pure engine), src/lib/server/{db,auth,modules,services,api,testing} (server only; services/* are the business layer shared by UI actions and the REST API; api/* is the REST infrastructure and OpenAPI), src/lib/components (Svelte components), src/lib/styles (_tokens.scss with light/dark mixins, global.scss), src/lib/{format,labels,live,tournaments,matchReports}.ts (shared helpers), src/routes/u/[username] (profile), src/routes/settings (profile settings + identities), src/routes/o/[org] (public org page + admin/), src/routes/t/[org]/[tournament]/ (public tournament pages + admin/ tabs), src/routes/api/v1/ (REST endpoints), src/routes/docs/api (API docs), drizzle/ (SQL migrations + meta), e2e/ (Playwright), messages/en.json (Paraglide), docs/PLAN.md (roadmap + implementation notes).
